model.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 Q8_0 with MXFP4 experts
model.verification: All four complete packs freshly SHA256-checked before profiling and inference; kept on read-only mounts.
model.gguf_manifest_note: Existing checksum manifest on read-only storage; only the full expert packs were freshly rehashed in this measurement session.

protocol.profile: Both builds reprofiled before inference; common main measurements used by all launches to control calibration.
protocol.storage: SHA256-verified identical expert packs; static expert/role mapping for main; adaptive replica routing for io/full.
protocol.sampling: native greedy generation, not fixed-token replay
protocol.cache: fresh server, prompt cache off, model-file POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED before each run
protocol.calibration: Both current builds ran built-in --reprofile before inference. All launches share the current main profile and the same explicit placement costs retained from the preceding bd2cd9f calibration at 12 prefill threads.
protocol.static_mapping: (3 * expert_index + role_index) % drive_count; role_index: up=0, gate=1, down=2. The two-drive subset uses the first and fourth packs.

limitations: Single machine/model/prompt; natural generation can diverge and change routing.
Matched manually pinned compute/memory configuration, not automatic thread counts or the previous GGUF alias experiment.
Existing pread-interposition prefetch fault tests skip the io_uring path; explicit short-read draining tests do run.
No claim of bitwise full-model equivalence, universal scaling or a completed cross-platform implementation.
